sloka: सुतौ दशरथस्येमौ धनुर्दर्शनकांक्षिणौ ।धनुर्दर्शय रामाय राजपुत्राय दैविकम् ॥ २.११८.४६॥
transliteration: sutau daśarathasyemau dhanurdarśanakāṁkṣiṇau ।dhanurdarśaya rāmāya rājaputrāya daivikam ॥ 2.118.46॥

translations.english: 'Both these sons of king Dasaratha wish to see the bow. Show the divine bow to prince Rama'.
